notes: Side-by-side boxes (PKHeX-style): in a Gen 3 game's Edit save → PC Boxes, tap the ⟷ button to see your game's boxes next to the Vault, with real Pokémon sprites. Click-drag a rubber-band to select several at once in either panel (or tap to toggle one), then hit 'Copy → Vault' or 'Copy → game' to move the whole selection across. Copies into a game back up the save first.
